title: Missing exception
original: Students below 75% attendance cannot appear for the examination unless the HOD approves.
rewritten: Students below 75% attendance cannot appear for the examination.

title: Changed threshold
original: Applicants must have at least 75% attendance.
rewritten: Applicants must have at least 70% attendance.

title: Obligation weakened
original: Candidates must submit the form before Friday.
rewritten: Candidates may submit the form before Friday.

title: Negation changed
original: Students who have not paid the fee are ineligible.
rewritten: Students who have paid the fee are ineligible.

title: No configured discrepancy
rewritten: The application must be submitted before 15 November.

title: Exception rephrased (review only)
original: Students cannot enter the laboratory unless the instructor approves.
rewritten: Students cannot enter the laboratory without the instructor's approval.

title: Several changes at once
original: Only final-year students may apply for the internship before 30 June 2025, provided their CGPA is at least 7.5.
rewritten: All students must apply for the internship after 30 June 2025.

title: Known limitation: 'and' vs 'or'
original: Leave applications must be approved by the class advisor and the HOD.
rewritten: Leave applications must be approved by the class advisor or the HOD.
